subject: Peer disposition: current Gen5 Beta1 V2 runtime patch REJECTED_BY_EVIDENCE pending five source-confirmed fixes
body: CURRENT_HEAD=b9bee812be0291f3956b698f46fe00ef45f188a6. V2 root-ready package independently extracted/validated PASS, but apply_gen5_beta1.py SHA256 remains ae308cf74ef3b13cf6162c8caa38802a0b4032ec267d15eabc25ea0686b54939, so V2 only fixes CI selector/support metadata and retains runtime defects. DISPOSITION=REJECTED_BY_EVIDENCE for this exact staged runtime revision, NOT for the Gen5 architecture. CONFIRMED blockers: (1) synthetic presentation timing: FrameCallback ignores frameTimeNanos, labels Display.mode.refreshRate as effectiveHz and feeds now+1/modeHz to predictor; use VsyncCallback/preferred FrameTimeline and measured cadence. (2) API35 ARR child path: root SurfaceControl vote does not directly control frame production; actual invalidating private FoldView has no requestedFrameRate=120/High and workflow allowlist currently prevents patching FoldOverlayView. (3) refresh ownership: mutable gen5RefreshRoot + async view.post has no attempt/generation/host token; delayed old-host request/clear can race newer opening. (4) glassAmount is computed but never consumed; shared legacy shader still couples geometry and blur. (5) stale inner-cache bootstrap: SnapshotCache is keyed only by innerPanel Boolean + dimensions, TTL=15 minutes, with no task/user/cycle provenance; Beta1 can present a prior inner screenshot nearly clear on cover. Preserve accepted visual-only core/bypass-TiltFollower/canonical crop/seamless request pieces. Fix these five, add targeted tests/static gates, rerun exact-baseline CI, then physical Fold7 matrix. Formal DUO-REVIEW/1 record persisted.
